body:
When flavor starts to fade, the quickest fix is usually a new pod or coil. Wintergreen Candy Off Stamp Sweet Cube Replacement Pod from Off Stamp is built to match its original device, so there is nothing to modify or adapt.

Wintergreen Candy Off Stamp Sweet Cube Replacement Pod is listed at $14.99 in our Coils & Pods range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Coils & Pods](/shop/coils-pods/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Wintergreen Candy Sweet Cube points to a crisp, chilled edge that keeps the profile fresh, with bold, confectionery-style flavor that stands out. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Off Stamp
- **Category:** Coils & Pods
- **Flavor:** Wintergreen Candy Sweet Cube
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $14.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Fresh coil in every pod:** restores flavor that has faded over time.
- **Designed to match the original device:** so it fits securely and connects without adapters.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Wintergreen Candy Off Stamp Sweet Cube Replacement Pod suits adult owners of the matching device who want to keep it running, and anyone who prefers to stock spares so they never run out.

## Using and caring for it
Confirm the product name matches your device before ordering, because pods and coils are not interchangeable between brands. Remove the old part, press the new one in until it seats, and let it rest for a minute before use. Dispose of used parts responsibly, store spares in a cool dry place, and keep them out of reach of children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
